principles: Contract-first: freeze the importable surface before any parallel impl starts
Pure functions only — the gate module performs no I/O
Keep the AuditConfig change type-only so Story 3 edits disjoint lines
drivers: Four parallel impl stories must import one stable surface
Must compile under tsc with no errors

options.name: single-file contract
pros: Minimal stable surface; one import path
Matches a single cohesive gate module
cons: Less granular than the spec multi-file template

options.name: barrel + separate types file
cons: Extra shared files raise scope-overlap risk

rationale: The gate is one cohesive module; a single parallel-decomposition.ts is the minimal stable surface and avoids extra files all four impls would share.

preMortem.trigger: impl stories import and build against it
preMortem.consequence: all four impls compile against a bad contract and need rework
preMortem.mitigation: derive signatures verbatim from spec 4.4, typed against real ScopeContractData/StoryInfo in core/types.ts

preMortem.scenario: audit-config field addition collides with Story 3
preMortem.trigger: Story 3 edits resolveAuditConfig in the same file
preMortem.consequence: merge conflict between Story 0 and Story 3
preMortem.mitigation: add only the interface field on its own line; Story 3 edits the resolveAuditConfig body — disjoint write-lines

preMortem.scenario: NotImplemented skeletons leak real logic or IO
preMortem.trigger: copying impl detail into the contract
preMortem.consequence: the frozen contract is no longer a pure skeleton
preMortem.mitigation: every body is exactly throw new Error(NotImplemented: <name>), verified by reading the diff
